messages:
nisha: Heads up - new int4 onboarding canary (harbor-liteq) shows uptick in funcall failures vs fp16 baseline. small but concentrated on short prompts and examples with non-ascii punctuation.
deploy-bot: canary=harbor-liteq-int4 parse_fail=0.9% -> 3.7% (24h)
brad: can you paste examples?
li: dropping a few (redacted):
`{"tool":"write_note","args":{"path":"/tmp/log.md","content":"Note: — reunión a las 10:00pm"}}`
`{'tool':'write_note','args':{'path':'/tmp/log.md','content':'Note - résumé: c'}}`
`{"tool":"write_note","args":"{\"path\":\"/tmp/x\",\"content\":\"概要：...\"}"}`
li: variants: smart quotes, single quotes, nested args-as-string. parser fails or accepts wrong shape.
axel: do we see any downstream correctness loss (wrong tool invoked) or just parse rejects?
nisha: both. ~40% are rejects; ~60% are coerced into wrong tool because keys translated or enum tokens changed.
brad: sounds like quantization changed tokenization leading to different split around punctuation and locale tokens. have we repro'd locally with seeds?
li: ran a small reproducer: int4 quant with default clip shows more non-ascii token emissions on short-context samples. fp16 is stable.
axel: mitigation proposals: 1) runtime cheap heuristics (smartquote normalize, single->double + unescape nested JSON), 2) lightweight detector to only run repair when likely, 3) per-locale fallback to fp16 for high-risk flows, 4) PTQ re-run with bias-preserve clip.
brad: also consider adding structured-output few-shot examples in the prompt in English-only to bias key names. might help but not perfect.
nisha: action: li run a 10k-sample sweep across en/es/ja with configs fp16, int4, int4+repair and record parse_accept, coercion_rate, wrong_tool_rate. briad/axel coordinate with quant team for a bias-preserve PTQ try.
li: starting sweep now, will post a short table in the channel tomorrow.
brad: if repair-only recovers >90% with low wrong_tool_rate we can enable repair in canary. otherwise keep affected locales on fp16.
axel: tagging @deploy-bot to mark samples where repair changed emitted payload so we can audit.
nisha: thanks all, we'll reconvene after results. :white_check_mark:
